reuse.why: Extends the existing shouldFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories selection and the hidden-mode enum instead of adding per-action checks; the goal_def predicate is new but the tree had no reusable 'has templates' check.

duplication.why: The template rule is added once in shouldFillCategory and both queries just select goal_def; nothing is copied.

placement.why: The rule sits in budget/actions.ts in the function the tree documents as the single definition of which categories month-wide actions write.

scope.why: Only the selection rule, the two queries, the setZero hidden mode and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised, but hasSavedTemplates was inserted between shouldFillCategory and its doc comment, the 'include' hidden mode is left unused, and the JSON-parse-with-catch-true is more defensive than the writer (which stores null for no templates) requires.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; copyPreviousMonth and all getMonthFillCategories callers use shouldFillCategory

one_place.where: shouldFillCategory in budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth directly and by setZero/averages via getMonthFillCategories
